races.title: BAR 1 Casino 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: NORMAN PRINCE caught the eye with his finishing effort when runner-up in a French bumper and can make a winning start over hurdles having since joined the Gigginstown/Elliott team. Fellow hurdling newcomers Huff'n'puff and Sunrush are also much respected on the strength of their Flat form. NORMAN PRINCE (FR) HUFF'N'PUFF SUNRUSH (IRE)

races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: The form of LA VALSERINE 's French bumper worked out extremely well and, having joined the all-conquering Mullins yard, she's taken to land what looks a warm mares maiden on hurdling debut. Moonverrin reached a useful level in bumpers and looks the pick of the potential dangers, though several others, including Royale Walk demand respect. LA VALSERINE (FR) MOONVERRIN (IRE) ROYALE WALK (IRE)

races.title: BAR 1 Betting 'Bet 10 Get 50' Tara Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: PADDY'S MILESTONE scored with something in hand in this race last year and he is fancied to land the prize again given his good record fresh. He gets the vote ahead of Mart Lane , who took another step forward when opening his account at Listowel, while Cool Native remains capable of better as she goes handicapping. PADDY'S MILESTONE (IRE) MART LANE (IRE) COOL NATIVE (IRE)

races.title: Race And Stay Irish EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict: A most interesting beginners chase with the narrow vote in favour of CLASSICAL CREEK . Absent since finishing down the field in Grade 1 company over hurdles at Naas in January, his profile prior to that was a most positive one and firmly appealing as the type to make an even better chaser, he can enhance his yard's solid recent record in this race. Fruit de Mer and Kopeck de Mee are others making plenty of appeal, with Forty Coats rounding off the shortlist. CLASSICAL CREEK FRUIT DE MER (IRE) KOPECK DE MEE (FR)

races.title: BAR 1 Betting Troytown Handicap Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict: Gordon Elliott is responsible for half the field so holds every chance of winning this for a record eighth time, with THE ENABLER looking the pick dropped to a more suitable trip. His stablemate Better Days Ahead has a good record here so is another to consider, while Uhavemeinstitches is lurking on a dangerous mark if it all comes together.
